name: figma_get_canvas_layout
description: Inspect top-level frames and artboards on the active Figma page to prevent overlap. Returns all screen coordinates, bounding box, and a calculated 'suggestedNextPosition' for placing new artboards safely.

direction.description: Placement direction relative to existing screens ('RIGHT' or 'BOTTOM', default: 'RIGHT')

limit.description: Maximum number of artboards to list, to prevent token bloat on pages with hundreds of frames (default: 200)

layout.description: 'row' (default) places along one axis per `direction`, like before. 'grid' shelf-packs into a `columns`-wide grid so a run of generated screens fills a compact rectangle instead of one long ribbon.

target.description: fileName of a specific connected Figma document, when more than one is open (see figma_list_targets).
